title: macOS Tahoe 26 Control Center
lede: Control Center on macOS Tahoe 26: clear glass circles and capsules that sit straight on the desktop wallpaper.
summary: Clear glass controls on the Mac desktop, with no panel behind them. Apple, 2025.

evidence.note: Inspected the Apple Newsroom image Apple-WWDC25-macOS-Tahoe-26-Control-Center-250609 (1960 × 1306, large_2x variant) in a scratchpad copy. A press render. Not stored.

styles.note: Shows the control layer alone: separate glass shapes with lit rims over the wallpaper, and no shared panel.

context: Apple: macOS Tahoe 26 “is crafted with Liquid Glass, a translucent new material that reflects and refracts its surroundings”. “The menu bar is now completely transparent”, and users can choose which controls appear in the menu bar and Control Center. [Apple Newsroom](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2025/06/macos-tahoe-26-makes-the-mac-more-capable-productive-and-intelligent-than-ever/).
observed: The upper-right corner of a MacBook screen with a blue, teal, and sand wave wallpaper. The menu bar has no background. Only the active Control Center icon sits in a light blue capsule.

Control Center has no window. Each control is its own glass shape: capsules for Wi-Fi and Focus, circles for Bluetooth and AirDrop, rounded rectangles for Now Playing, Display, and Sound, and a row of four circles.
Each shape is nearly clear, takes the blue of the wallpaper, and has a bright rim that is strongest on the upper-left edge.
Active toggles (Bluetooth, AirDrop) are opaque white circles with blue glyphs. The Display and Sound sliders are deeper blue glass with white tracks.
Gaps between shapes are equal, and inner corners follow the outer corners.
interpretation: Removing the panel and keeping only separate glass controls is the clearest sign of the style’s two-layer idea: the controls float, and nothing else is glass.
borrow: Show an active state as an opaque fill inside the glass set, and keep inactive controls clear.

rights.statement: Apple press image of copyrighted software. No image is stored here.

related: See also [the iOS 26 Home Screen](ref:ios-26-home-screen-2025) and the overview record [Apple Liquid Glass](ref:apple-liquid-glass-2025).
